name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while reducing visual noise, which matters for users with cognitive or vestibular sensitivities. The trade-off is a slightly softer ring that may blend more on high-contrast displays, but the inset ensures clarity without harsh edges.

name: Reader
text: The 2px #005fcc ring with 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds where the white inset disappears, leaving only a faint blue ring. A safer alternative is a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff outer stroke—it meets contrast on all backgrounds and is easier to see for users with low vision. Test both options with a screen reader and high-contrast mode to settle it.
